basic_details.job_title: CSIR CGCRI Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute (CSIR-CGCRI), Kolkata, needs one Project Associate - I (PAT - I) for the CSIR-sponsored project "Flexible Biomimetic Sensors-based Point-of-Care Testing for Temporomandibular Joint Dysfunction". The position is initially for 1 year and can be extended up to 31.03.2031, based on the availability of funds. The stipend is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for candidates with NET, GATE or an equivalent national-level examination, and Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for all others. The post is open to Indian citizens with a B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc in the listed disciplines. Candidat

important_dates.interview_date: 04/11/2026 from 11.00 a.m. (report at least one hour before)

age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 years as on the date of the interview. The upper age limit can be relaxed as follows: | Category Relaxation SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female Up to 5 years OBCs (Non-Creamy layer candidates) 3 years

qualification.details: B.E./ B/Tech in Electronics & Communication Engg./ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics & Instrumentation Engg./ Mechatronics/ Robotics/ Instrumentation Engg Or, M.Sc in Physics/ Chemistry/ Electronics Sciences/ Instrumentation Science

how_to_apply: Applications must be sent by email and must be received by 2 November 2026. No application will be considered after this date.
Fill in the application form in the prescribed format that comes with the notice. The form must be TYPED, not handwritten.
Prepare self-attested soft copies of every supporting document, certificate and reprint.
Attach the soft copy of the filled application form and the self-attested documents.
Send the email to [email protected] by 2 November 2026.
If you are applying for more than one position or advertisement number, send a separate application for each one.
Duly filled application form in the prescribed format (typed)
Self-attested soft copies of every supporting document, certificate and reprint
Self-attested soft copy of the University/Institute's CGPA/DGPA-to-percentage calculation rule, where it applies
Copy of the NOC from the existing Project Leader, for candidates currently working in a project at CSIR-CGCRI or any other organisation, lab or institute
Incomplete applications, and applications not in the prescribed format or without supporting documents, will be rejected without further consideration.
important_instructions: CSIR-CGCRI reserves the right not to fill the position if the Competent Authority so decides. The number of positions may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the Institute. The decision of the Institute is final. Interim enquiries will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview is open to bonafide Indian citizens. Candidates must meet the essential qualification. The age limit applies as on the date of the interview. B.E./ B/Tech in Electronics & Communication Engg./ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics & Instrumentation Engg./ Mechatronics/ Robotics/ Instrumentation Engg Or, M.Sc in Physics/ Chemistry/ Electronics Sciences/ Instrumentation Science Experience in Digital Signal Processing/ Embedded Systems/ Spin coating. The age limit is 35 years as on the date of the interview. The upper age limit can be relaxed as follows: Candidates whose results are awaited will not be eligible. Candidates must calculate their percentage from CGPA/DGPA as per the calculation rule of their University/Institute and attach a self-attested soft copy of that rule. Candidates who are currently working in any project, either in CSIR-CGCRI or in any other organisation, lab or institute, must submit a copy of an NOC from their existing Project Leader. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid on top of the stipend at both rates. The position is a project position under project OLP2306 at CSIR-CGCRI, Kolkata. It is initially for 1 year and can be extended up to 31.03.2031, based on the availability of funds.

rows.pay_stipend: Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ ICAR/ ICMR NET including Lectureship / Assistant Professorship, or GATE, or a National Level Examination conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/ DST or equivalent and/or their agencies or institutions
Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others who do not fall under the category above

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I (PAT - I)
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by email and must be received by 2 November 2026. No application will be considered after this date. Duly filled application form in the prescribed format (typed) Self-attested soft copies of every supporting document, certificate and reprint Self-attested soft copy of the University/Institute's CGPA/DGPA-to-percentage calculation rule, where it applies Copy of the NOC from the existing Project Leader, for candidates currently working in a project at CSIR-CGCRI or any other organisation, lab or institute Incomplete applications, and applications not in the prescribed format or without supporting documents, will be rejected without further consideration.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through a walk-in interview at CSIR-CGCRI on 4 November 2026 from 11.00 a.m. Before the interview, documents will be checked. Report at least one hour before the scheduled interview time for document verification. Bring the original marksheets, certificates and age/caste proof. Bring self-attested copies of all documents, and your project thesis if you have one. Candidates who arrive after the reporting time will not be allowed to enter the Institute.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-CGCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Associate - I (PAT - I), Post Code 55/2627/01, under project OLP2306 at CSIR-CGCRI, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by email by 2 November 2026. No application will be considered after that date.

faq.question: Q3. When is the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 November 2026 from 11.00 a.m. at CSIR-CGCRI. Candidates must report at least one hour before the scheduled time for document verification.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./ B/Tech in Electronics & Communication Engg./ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics & Instrumentation Engg./ Mechatronics/ Robotics/ Instrumentation Engg, or an M.Sc in Physics/ Chemistry/ Electronics Sciences/ Instrumentation Science. Experience in Digital Signal Processing/ Embedded Systems/ Spin coating is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on the date of the interview. SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female candidates get a relaxation of up to 5 years, and OBC (Non-Creamy layer) candidates get 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for candidates who have qualified NET (CSIR-UGC/ ICAR/ ICMR), GATE or an equivalent national-level examination. All other candidates get Rs. 25,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I stipend?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid in addition to the stipend at both rates, Rs. 31,000/- and Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Email a soft copy of the typed application form in the prescribed format to [email protected], together with self-attested soft copies of all supporting documents, by 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a project position, initially for 1 year, and it can be extended up to 31.03.2031 based on the availability of funds.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates whose results are awaited apply for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: No. Candidates whose results are awaited are not eligible for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post.
